# Gestalt

> Declarative gesture recognition for hand-tracked spatial interfaces, plus a tunable
> eval harness. Gestures are written as YAML, compiled into explicit temporal state
> machines you can inspect while they run, and measured against labeled sessions
> (precision, recall, false positives per minute, latency from true onset) so you can
> tell whether a threshold change actually helped.

The live demo replays synthetic hand-tracking sessions (generated by the test suite's
hand poser, not recorded from a camera), or uses your camera via MediaPipe, through the
same compiled machines as the test suite, with a real-time inspector showing every
state, transition, and guard value.

The eval corpus is 34 synthetic sessions. Every gesture scores 1.000 precision and
recall on it, which shows the machines match their fixtures; it is not a measure of
real-world camera accuracy.

## Links

- Live demo: https://gestalt-pearl.vercel.app/
- How it works: https://gestalt-pearl.vercel.app/about.html
- Source: https://github.com/TarunYadgirkar/gestalt-gesture-dsl
